content: In episode 109 of the popular U.S. science show Mythbusters, the hosts attempted to manipulate polygraph results by employing specific techniques. One method involved inducing physical pain while answering truthfully, with the intention of elevating physiological readings so that truthful and deceptive answers would appear indistinguishable to the polygraph. Another method involved cognitive manipulation, where they tried to think of happy, calming thoughts while lying and stressful, anxiety-inducing thoughts while telling the truth, aiming to confuse the machine's interpretation of their responses. However, neither of these techniques proved effective. Michael Martin, the polygraph examiner, was able to accurately identify which subjects were guilty and which were innocent. The show also highlighted the widely accepted belief that, when conducted properly, polygraphs are accurate approximately 80-99% of the time.
